SETTING AND CONTINUITY: daylight Hogwarts LIBRARY corridor. Hermione has changed OFFSCREEN to full ordinary Gryffindor school uniform: very voluminous brown curls, freckles, brown eyes, burgundy/gold tie/robe, white shirt, gray sweater. Daphne has ordinary Slytherin uniform: long wavy blonde hair, blue eyes, green/silver tie/robe. Reference1 supplies these two faces and the warm library. Both fully clothed, carrying books. 1. Hermione walks out of the library carrying a LARGE but manageable stack of books that obscures her mouth slightly. Daphne approaches cheerfully from the side: «¡Te busqué por todas partes!»
2. Hermione peeks over the books: «Hola, Daphne.» Daphne offers help with an open hand, not yet touching: «Déjame ayudarte.»
3. Daphne performs a small neat wand flick; Hermione's OWN books gently float away down a corridor toward safety. Hermione, surprised: «¡Mis libros! ¿Qué…?»
4. Daphne calmly reassures her: «Los envié a un lugar seguro. Los recuperarás más tarde.» The floating stack remains distant.
5. Hermione, puzzled, asks: «¿Por qué no ahora?» Daphne offers her forearm for Hermione to take if she chooses: «Porque ya nos esperan.» Hermione asks: «¿Quiénes?»
6. Daphne smiles mysteriously: «Espera y verás.» The two walk along the sunlit corridor side-by-side toward stairs. Keep the destination unseen; do not show Slytherin spaces yet.
